Within [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban's]] [[Valley of Golg]] was the [[Dathka Graush's tomb|tomb]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]], wherein the ancient sovereign's '''[[Sith sarcophagus|sarcophagus]]''' was kept. The coffin contained a [[Sith sword]], [[Dathka Graush's holocron]], and the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Heart of Graush|crystal]] he once used in place of his [[Heart/Legends|heart]]. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the tomb was visited by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Naz Felyood]], who found the sarcophagus and plundered its contents.
